Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.A. No. 317/2021

Dear Ms. Bhatt,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 August 2022 about your dispute with Gayatri Iyengar. As we understand it, the landlord needs the premises for the family's own use.

Our advice is to plead bona fide personal need with proof of the family's housing requirement. Please collect proof of the family's housing requirement and the property tax records and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 4,40,000.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
